mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drawing (drawing_code, drawing_name, file_format, file_size, storage_path, preview_path, preview_status, latest_version, material_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES (CONVERT(NVARCHAR(64),#{drawingCode}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(256),#{drawingName}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16),#{fileFormat}), #{fileSize}, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(512),#{storagePath}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(512),#{previewPath}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16),#{previewStatus}), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32),#{latestVersion}), #{materialId}, #{createdBy}, GETDATE())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM drawing WHERE drawing_code LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' OR drawing_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drawing WHERE material_id = #{materialId}
SELECT * FROM drawing ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM drawing WHERE created_at >= DATEADD(day, -#{days} + 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS stat_date, ISNULL(SUM(file_size), 0) AS total_size FROM drawing WHERE created_at >= DATEADD(day, -#{days} + 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY stat_date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drawing WHERE CAST(created_at AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(file_format) = 'pdf' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pdf_count, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(file_format) IN ('sldprt','sldasm','step','stp','iges','igs') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS model3d_count, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(file_format) IN ('slddrw','dwg','dxf') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS engineering_count FROM drawing
